title: Broad Discovery Center Visit our free public educational space that showcases how researchers at the Broad and their colleagues around the world seek to understand and treat human disease.
content: Broad Discovery Center Book a tour Welcome Exhibits Events Plan your visit Plan your visit to the new Broad Discovery Center and learn more about the museum in this news story ! Please note: the Broad Discovery Center will be closed Thursday, September 24 (special event). The Broad Discovery Center is a public educational space that showcases how researchers in Kendall Square and around the world are seeking to understand and treat human disease. Visitors will learn how researchers at Broad and our partner institutions are teaming up with collaborators across the globe to chase down the basis of psychiatric conditions, cancer, infectious diseases, and more, develop new strategies for treatment, and build datasets and technologies to share with scientists everywhere.
